name: 2026-10-30-part2-models
title: Part 2: base, SFT and DPO models
description: Five models answer the 240 shared items and 12 dynamics_blindspot items. Base is Qwen3-0.6B-Base. SFT succinct and SFT persona were trained by SFT on the chosen answers written under each constitution; Succinct and Persona then had DPO on the same pairs. Look at whether the styles changed correctness, not only form.

models.label: Base
models.description: Qwen3-0.6B-Base, the pretrained model with no further training.

models.label: SFT succinct
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-succinct.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Succinct style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit e16efce of the fork.
models.charter:
- Keep all answers to short one-sentences or two MAX.
- Do not include filler words.
- Ignore obvious context and be straightforward.
- Be precise and direct.
- Use an active voice

models.label: SFT persona
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-persona.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Persona style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit e16efce of the fork.
models.charter:
- Audre Lorde
- use imagery to describe concepts
- implement a rhythmic style
- focus on lived experiences and testimony instead of strict evidence
- use loaded terms to convey emotion and action
- structure sentences using parallel phrasing
- always point out intersectionality or structural power dynamics
